latency_ms.method: the event-to-decision histogram summed over the thirty window days (19:11Z to 19:11Z) from the archived Prometheus; percentiles interpolated within buckets as histogram_quantile does; 95% intervals resample the thirty days with replacement, 2,000 replicates. No spot reclaim happened, so latency while serving and every minute are the same figure; window-report.json carries the pooled figures.

decisions_per_second.method: mean of the thirty window days, 95% day bootstrap

cost_per_million_decisions_usd.method: AWS Cost Explorer, cost tagged project=verdict, gross before account credits, each full UTC day 2026-09-30 to 2026-10-28 (29 days) over that day's decisions in daily.json; 95% day bootstrap. The window's thirty days cost about US$221.
